Batch-read FragPipe psm.tsv files and merge them

Source: R/loaders-fragpipe.R
read_fragpipe_batch.Rd

Reads all FragPipe psm.tsv files and row-binds the result. Three input modes are supported (checked in priority order):

Usage

read_fragpipe_batch(
  folder = NULL,
  annotation = NULL,
  files = NULL,
  testmode = FALSE
)

Arguments

folder

Top-level directory. Required when using the annotation or scan-all modes; unused when files is supplied.

annotation

Optional annotation data frame (output of read_annot()). When provided without files, only Sample_fp entries present in annotation are read.

files

Optional character vector of psm.tsv file paths or parent folder paths to read directly.

testmode

Logical; passed through to read_fragpipe() (keeps only the first ~100 rows per run when TRUE, for fast iteration).

Value

The merged raw PSM data frame across every file found, with Sample_fp identifying the source subfolder of each row.

Details

  1. files — character vector of psm.tsv file paths or their parent folder paths; sample names are taken from the immediate parent folder.

  2. annotation — only the Sample_fp entries listed in the annotation table are read from folder; warns about any annotated samples not found on disk.

  3. neither — folder is scanned recursively for every psm.tsv (original default behaviour).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# scan entire folder
read_fragpipe_batch(file.path("2_data", "fragpipe_dda_combined"), testmode = FALSE)

# restrict to annotated samples only
read_fragpipe_batch(folder = "2_data", annotation = annot)

# provide paths explicitly
read_fragpipe_batch(files = c("2_data/fragpipe/JY_1/psm.tsv", "2_data/fragpipe/JY_2"))
} # }
